## Important info

This will clash with any custom skin that modifies High Noon Lucian chromas. 1 file for all chromas. You must own the skin and chromas.

## Description

**Author**: Suriin

**Skin**: High Noon Lucian

**Affects**: VFX colors

Adds matching VFX to every chroma, base remains the same. A person wanted white particles on pearl chroma so you can find a second version of this mod in the releases tab.
